model_info.name: Kisan Drishti MobileNetV3 Disease Knowledge Engine

symptoms: Olive-green to brown velvety lesions on upper leaf
Dark scab-like spots on fruit skin
Premature defoliation in severe cases
Distorted or cracked fruit surface
environmental_factors: Cool and wet spring weather (10-24 C)
Apple___Apple_scab.organic_treatment: Apply sulfur-based fungicide (Wettable Sulfur 80% WP at 3g/L). Use lime-sulfur spray during dormant season. Remove and destroy fallen infected leaves. Apply neem oil (3%) fortnightly. Prune for better air circulation.
Apple___Apple_scab.chemical_treatment: Apply Captan 50% WP at 2g/L or Carbendazim 50% WP at 1g/L. Alternate with Mancozeb 75% WP at 2.5g/L every 10-14 days. Begin at green tip stage.
similar_outbreaks_globally: China: Apple scab outbreak - Shaanxi province (2023)
Russia: Apple scab - Krasnodar region (2022)

symptoms: Purple-ringed tan spots on leaves (frogeye spots)
Concentric rings on rotting fruit turning black
Cankers on limbs with reddish-brown discoloration
Mummified fruit remaining on tree
environmental_factors: Mechanical wounds on fruit and bark
Apple___Black_rot.organic_treatment: Prune and destroy infected branches. Apply copper hydroxide at 2g/L. Remove mummified fruit immediately. Apply Trichoderma viride-based biocontrol agents. Use protective Bordeaux mixture (1%).
Apple___Black_rot.chemical_treatment: Apply Thiophanate-methyl 70% WP at 1.5g/L or Myclobutanil 10% WP at 0.5g/L. Start at petal fall and repeat every 10 days.
similar_outbreaks_globally: Brazil: Apple rot - Santa Catarina (2022)
South Africa: Apple black rot - Western Cape (2023)

symptoms: Bright orange-yellow spots on upper leaf surface
Tube-like structures (aecia) on lower leaf surface
Defoliation and fruit deformation
Lesions on fruit and twigs
environmental_factors: Requires alternate host (Eastern Red Cedar / Juniper)
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.organic_treatment: Remove nearby juniper/cedar hosts. Apply sulfur spray (80% WP at 3g/L) from bud break through petal fall. Use copper-based fungicides protectively.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.chemical_treatment: Apply Myclobutanil 10% WP at 0.5g/L or Propiconazole 25% EC at 0.75 mL/L. Apply at pink bud stage, petal fall, and 10 days after.
similar_outbreaks_globally: USA: Cedar apple rust - Virginia and Carolina states (2023)

symptoms: No visible disease symptoms detected
Leaves appear green, glossy, and intact
Apple___healthy.organic_treatment: Continue current IPM practices. Apply balanced NPK fertilizer. Prune annually for sunlight penetration.

symptoms: No disease symptoms detected
Blueberry___healthy.organic_treatment: Maintain acidic soil pH (4.5-5.5). Apply mulch to retain moisture and suppress weeds.

symptoms: White powdery mycelial growth on leaf surface
Leaves curl inward (cupping) and turn white
Deformed, stunted young shoots
Fruit scarring and reduced size
environmental_factors: Warm dry days with cool nights
Dense canopy with poor air circulation
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.organic_treatment: Apply potassium bicarbonate (5g/L) or neem oil (5 mL/L with emulsifier). Remove infected shoots. Use Trichoderma harzianum spray.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.chemical_treatment: Apply Wettable Sulfur 80% WP at 2.5g/L or Hexaconazole 5% EC at 1 mL/L. Spray at 10-day intervals. Do not apply sulfur when temperature exceeds 32 C.
similar_outbreaks_globally: China: Sweet cherry mildew - Dalian (2023)

symptoms: No disease symptoms detected
Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.organic_treatment: Maintain regular pruning. Apply calcium foliar sprays to strengthen cell walls.

symptoms: Long rectangular gray-tan lesions parallel to leaf veins
Distinct parallel margins on lesions
Premature senescence of lower leaves
Entire plant defoliation in severe cases
environmental_factors: Minimum tillage systems with corn residue on field
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.organic_treatment: Use resistant hybrid varieties. Rotate crops (avoid continuous corn). Incorporate crop residues by deep tillage. Apply Pseudomonas fluorescens bio-fungicide at 5g/L.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.chemical_treatment: Apply Propiconazole 25% EC at 1 mL/L or Azoxystrobin 23% SC at 1 mL/L. Start at VT (tasseling) stage. Repeat once at silking if conditions persist.
similar_outbreaks_globally: Brazil: Corn GLS outbreak - Mato Grosso (2023)
South Africa: Maize gray leaf spot - Mpumalanga (2022)

symptoms: Cinnamon-brown oval pustules on both leaf surfaces
Pustules rupture releasing brick-red to brown spores
Heavy infection leads to leaf yellowing and premature death
environmental_factors: Wind-dispersal of spores from alternate host regions
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.organic_treatment: Plant resistant hybrid varieties. Apply neem-based fungicide (1.5%) at early pustule stage. Apply silica-based foliar to strengthen leaf cuticle.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.chemical_treatment: Apply Mancozeb 75% WP at 2.5g/L or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC at 1 mL/L. Spray at first sign of pustules. Repeat every 14 days if needed.
similar_outbreaks_globally: India: Corn rust - Himachal Pradesh hills (2023)
China: Maize rust - Yunnan province (2022)

symptoms: Long (5-15 cm) cigar-shaped grayish-green lesions
Lesions turn tan-brown as they mature
Olive-green spore masses visible under humid conditions
Whole leaf killed in severe infections
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.organic_treatment: Use resistant varieties. Crop rotation with non-host crops (soybean, wheat). Deep plowing to bury infected residue. Apply Bacillus subtilis-based bioagent at 5g/L.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.chemical_treatment: Apply Propiconazole 25% EC at 0.75 mL/L or Azoxystrobin + Propiconazole at label rate. Apply at early tassel stage. Repeat after 14 days.
similar_outbreaks_globally: India: NCLB in Punjab - Kharif season (2022)
Brazil: Northern blight in corn belt (2023)

symptoms: No disease symptoms detected
Corn_(maize)___healthy.organic_treatment: Continue with integrated nutrient management. Ensure balanced N-P-K fertilization. Practice recommended plant density.

symptoms: Small tan spots with dark borders on leaves
Black, shriveled mummified berries
Dark lesions on shoots and tendrils
Berries shrivel entirely before harvest
environmental_factors: Rainfall during early season fruit development
Infected mummified berries left from previous season
Grape___Black_rot.organic_treatment: Remove mummified berries and infected debris. Apply copper hydroxide (50% WP at 2g/L) protectively. Spray lime-sulfur during dormancy. Improve canopy airflow by pruning.
Grape___Black_rot.chemical_treatment: Apply Myclobutanil 10% WP at 0.5g/L or Mancozeb 75% WP at 2.5g/L from early shoot growth. Spray every 7-10 days during wet periods.
similar_outbreaks_globally: South Africa: Grape black rot - Stellenbosch (2022)
China: Grape rot - Xinjiang vineyards (2023)

symptoms: Tiger-striped leaf discoloration (interveinal chlorosis)
Small dark-colored berries - the measles symptom
Internal wood darkening in cross-section
Sudden wilting of entire shoot (apoplexy)
environmental_factors: Pruning wounds in wet weather (primary infection)
Old vine stress (>15 year old vines more susceptible)
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).organic_treatment: Protect pruning wounds with Trichoderma paste. Avoid pruning during wet weather. Remove severely infected vines. Apply Bacillus amyloliquefaciens foliar spray.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).chemical_treatment: No curative fungicide exists. Apply Boscalid + Pyraclostrobin at pruning to protect wounds. Focus on wound protection and sanitation.
similar_outbreaks_globally: Spain: Esca trunk disease (2022)
South Africa: Vineyard trunk disease - Paarl (2023)

symptoms: Dark brown irregular angular lesions on leaves
Grayish-white sporulation on lesion underside
Leaf curling and premature drop
Reduced photosynthesis and weakened vine
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.organic_treatment: Remove and destroy infected leaves. Apply copper oxychloride (50% WP at 3g/L) every 10-14 days. Improve canopy management and air circulation.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.chemical_treatment: Apply Carbendazim 50% WP at 1g/L or Thiophanate-methyl 70% WP at 1.5g/L every 10-14 days.
similar_outbreaks_globally: India: Grape leaf blight - Nashik, Maharashtra (2022)

symptoms: No disease symptoms detected
Grape___healthy.organic_treatment: Maintain proper canopy management. Apply compost and vermicompost. Ensure balanced irrigation.

symptoms: Asymmetric (blotchy) mottled yellow leaves
Stunted growth, twig die-back, sparse foliage
Small, lopsided fruit remaining partially green
Bitter, salty, non-marketable fruit
environmental_factors: Spread by Asian citrus psyllid (Diaphorina citri) vector
No immunity in any commercially grown citrus variety
Once infected, tree decline is irreversible
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).organic_treatment: There is NO cure. Remove and destroy infected trees immediately to prevent spread. Control psyllid vector using neem oil spray (5 mL/L). Introduce Tamarixia radiata parasitic wasp for biological vector control.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).chemical_treatment: Control psyllid vector with Imidacloprid 17.8% SL at 0.3 mL/L. Quarantine infected areas strictly. Plant only certified disease-free nursery stock.
similar_outbreaks_globally: Brazil: HLB destroyed 100M trees - Sao Paulo state (ongoing)
China: Citrus greening - Guangdong, Fujian (2022)
India: Citrus decline - Vidarbha, Maharashtra (2023)

symptoms: Small water-soaked spots on leaves turning brown with yellow halos
Irregular shot-holes as necrotic tissue falls out
Sunken, cracked lesions on fruit surface
Severe defoliation by mid-season
environmental_factors: Warm, rainy weather during shoot growth
High nitrogen applications promoting succulent tissue
Peach___Bacterial_spot.organic_treatment: Apply copper hydroxide (53.8% at 2g/L) from shuck fall at 10-14 day intervals. Avoid overhead irrigation. Plant in well-drained soils.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.chemical_treatment: Apply Oxytetracycline (Mycoshield) at 0.4g/L if registered. Tank-mix copper + Mancozeb for broader protection. Apply 4-6 sprays from petal fall through late season.
similar_outbreaks_globally: China: Peach bacterial spot - Shandong province (2022)

symptoms: No disease symptoms detected
Peach___healthy.organic_treatment: Apply balanced organic fertilizer. Prune to maintain open center canopy structure.

symptoms: Small water-soaked circular spots on leaves becoming brown
Yellow halos surrounding leaf spots
Raised, scabby lesions on fruit surface
Defoliation leaving fruits exposed to sunscald
environmental_factors: Warm temperatures (24-30 C) with frequent rainfall
Windblown rain driving bacteria into stomata
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.organic_treatment: Apply copper hydroxide (50% WP at 2g/L) from transplant stage every 7-10 days. Use pathogen-free certified seed. Apply Pseudomonas fluorescens at 5g/L as biocontrol.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.chemical_treatment: Apply copper-mancozeb combination. Streptocycline (100 ppm) + copper oxychloride (0.3%) spray for bacterial control.
similar_outbreaks_globally: India: Capsicum bacterial spot - Himachal Pradesh (2022)
China: Bell pepper disease - Shandong (2023)

symptoms: No disease symptoms detected
Pepper,_bell___healthy.organic_treatment: Apply vermicompost and balanced fertilizer. Maintain proper plant spacing for air circulation.

symptoms: Dark brown circular spots with concentric ring patterns (bullseye)
Yellow halo surrounding lesions
Begins on older/lower leaves and progresses upward
Premature defoliation reducing photosynthesis
Potato___Early_blight.organic_treatment: Apply copper oxychloride (50% WP at 3g/L) every 7-10 days. Remove infected lower leaves. Apply neem oil (3%) + garlic extract foliar. Ensure adequate potassium nutrition.
Potato___Early_blight.chemical_treatment: Apply Mancozeb 75% WP at 2.5g/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP at 2g/L. Alternate with Iprodione 50% WP at 2g/L to prevent resistance.
similar_outbreaks_globally: India: Potato early blight - UP and Bihar (2022)
China: Potato blight - Inner Mongolia (2023)

symptoms: Dark brown water-soaked lesions on leaf margins
White cottony fungal sporulation on leaf underside in humid conditions
Rapid lesion expansion - entire leaf can die within days
Stem necrosis at soil line and brown rot of tubers
environmental_factors: Heavy rainfall or extended foggy conditions
Dense crop canopy preventing leaf drying
Potato___Late_blight.organic_treatment: Apply Bordeaux mixture (1%) every 5-7 days during cool, wet weather. Copper hydroxide at 2g/L as protective spray. Avoid overhead irrigation. Use resistant varieties (Kufri Jyoti, Kufri Khyati).
Potato___Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Apply Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold MZ) at 2g/L. Alternate with Cymoxanil + Mancozeb (Curzate) at 2.5g/L every 5-7 days.
similar_outbreaks_globally: India: Late blight - Punjab, Haryana (2022)
Brazil: Batata late blight - Minas Gerais (2023)
South Africa: Potato blight - Limpopo (2022)

symptoms: No disease symptoms detected
Potato___healthy.organic_treatment: Maintain earthing-up practice. Apply balanced fertilizer with adequate potassium. Use certified disease-free seed tubers.
Potato___healthy.chemical_treatment: No treatment required. Apply preventive copper spray as precaution during humid seasons.

symptoms: No disease symptoms detected
Raspberry___healthy.organic_treatment: Apply compost mulch. Prune old floricanes after harvest.

symptoms: No disease symptoms detected
Soybean___healthy.organic_treatment: Apply Rhizobium inoculant for nitrogen fixation. Maintain proper plant spacing and crop rotation.

symptoms: White powdery spots on upper and lower leaf surfaces
Leaves turn entirely white in severe infection
Yellowing and premature senescence of leaves
Stunted fruit development
environmental_factors: Warm dry days, cool nights, high relative humidity at night
Squash___Powdery_mildew.organic_treatment: Spray baking soda solution (sodium bicarbonate 5g/L + vegetable oil 5 mL/L). Apply milk spray (10% whole milk dilution). Use neem oil (3%) + wetting agent. Ensure adequate plant spacing.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.chemical_treatment: Apply Wettable Sulfur 80% WP at 2.5g/L or Triadimefon 25% WP at 0.5g/L. Spray every 7-10 days. Do not apply sulfur when temperature exceeds 32 C.
similar_outbreaks_globally: India: Cucurbit powdery mildew - Rajasthan (2022)

symptoms: Small, irregular purple spots on leaf surface
Centers of spots turn brown/gray, edges remain purple
Severe infection leads to leaf scorch appearance
Defoliation and plant stunting
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.organic_treatment: Remove infected leaves before renovation. Apply neem-based fungicide (3%). Use drip irrigation instead of overhead irrigation. Plant disease-resistant varieties.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.chemical_treatment: Apply Captan 50% WP at 2g/L or Myclobutanil 10% WP at 0.5g/L every 10 days. Start at early spring growth resumption.

symptoms: No disease symptoms detected
Strawberry___healthy.organic_treatment: Apply compost mulch. Remove old leaves regularly. Use drip irrigation.

symptoms: Small dark brown water-soaked lesions with yellow halos on leaves
Irregular raised scabby spots on fruit surface
Defoliation leaving fruit exposed to sunscald
Blighted appearance of young seedlings
environmental_factors: Warm, wet and windy weather (24-30 C)
Infected transplants or infected seed lots
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.organic_treatment: Apply copper hydroxide (53.8% WP at 2g/L) every 5-7 days. Use certified pathogen-free seed. Avoid working in field when plants are wet. Apply Pseudomonas fluorescens (5g/L) as biocontrol.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.chemical_treatment: Apply Streptocycline (100 ppm) + Copper oxychloride (0.3%). Alternate with Kasugamycin 3% SL at 1.5 mL/L. Spray from early plant growth through fruiting stage.
similar_outbreaks_globally: India: Tomato bacterial spot - Karnataka and AP (2022)
Brazil: Tomato spot - Goias state (2023)

symptoms: Dark brown circular spots with concentric ring bullseye pattern
Yellow chlorotic halo around lesions
Starts on older lower leaves moving upward
Fruit stem-end rot - dark leathery lesion at calyx end
Tomato___Early_blight.organic_treatment: Apply copper oxychloride (50% WP at 3g/L) or Bordeaux mixture (1%) every 7-10 days. Remove lower infected leaves. Apply neem oil spray (3%). Ensure adequate fertilization especially potassium.
Tomato___Early_blight.chemical_treatment: Apply Mancozeb 75% WP at 2.5g/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP at 2g/L. Alternate with Difenconazole 25% EC at 0.5 mL/L to manage resistance.
similar_outbreaks_globally: India: Tomato early blight - Himachal Pradesh (2022)
China: Tomato alternaria blight - Shandong (2023)

symptoms: Dark brown water-soaked lesions expanding rapidly on leaf margins
White fuzzy sporulation visible on lower leaf surface in humid conditions
Brown-black firm lesions on green fruit
Stem necrosis - dark brown streaking on stems
environmental_factors: Cool, wet weather (10-20 C) with high humidity (>90%)
Extended periods of rain, fog, or heavy dew
Dense plant canopy with poor air circulation
Tomato___Late_blight.organic_treatment: Apply Bordeaux mixture (1%) every 5-7 days during cool, wet weather. Copper hydroxide at 2g/L spray. Remove infected plant material immediately. Improve air circulation by staking. Avoid wet-season overhead irrigation.
Tomato___Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Apply Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold) at 2g/L every 7 days. Alternate with Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP at 2.5g/L. In resistant strains use Ametoctradin + Dimethomorph.
similar_outbreaks_globally: India: Tomato blight - Himachal Pradesh, Nilgiris (2022)
Brazil: Late blight - Minas Gerais (2023)
South Africa: Tomato blight - Limpopo (2022)

symptoms: Pale yellowish-green spots on upper leaf surface
Olive-green to brown velvety mold growth on leaf underside
Leaves turn brown and dry in advanced stages
Primarily occurs in greenhouse / protected cultivation
environmental_factors: Very high humidity (>85%) - especially in greenhouses
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.organic_treatment: Increase greenhouse ventilation immediately. Reduce humidity by improving air circulation. Apply potassium bicarbonate spray (5g/L). Remove heavily infected leaves. Avoid wetting foliage during irrigation.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.chemical_treatment: Apply Chlorothalonil 75% WP at 2g/L or Difenconazole 25% EC at 0.5 mL/L. Spray every 7-10 days. Rotate fungicide classes to prevent resistance.
similar_outbreaks_globally: India: Greenhouse tomato leaf mold - Pune, Maharashtra (2023)

symptoms: Small circular spots (1-4 mm) with dark brown margins and tan/gray centers
Tiny black specks (pycnidia) visible in center of spots
Begins on lower/older leaves moving upward
Severe defoliation, no direct fruit infection
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.organic_treatment: Remove infected leaves promptly. Apply copper-based fungicide (copper hydroxide 50% at 2g/L) every 7-10 days. Avoid overhead watering. Apply organic mulch to prevent soil splash.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.chemical_treatment: Apply Mancozeb 75% WP at 2.5g/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP at 2g/L. Start at first symptom appearance and spray every 7-10 days.
similar_outbreaks_globally: India: Tomato septoria - Kolar, Karnataka (2022)

symptoms: Tiny yellow or white stippling dots on upper leaf surface
Bronzing and russeting of leaves in severe infestation
Fine silk webbing on leaves and growing tips
Leaf curl, desiccation, and premature drop
environmental_factors: Hot and dry conditions (>30 C, low humidity)
Excessive nitrogen fertilization promoting succulent tissue
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.organic_treatment: Apply neem oil (5 mL/L with soap) spray on leaf undersides every 5-7 days. Release predatory mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis). Spray cold water jets on undersides to dislodge mites.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.chemical_treatment: Apply Abamectin 1.9% EC at 0.5 mL/L or Hexythiazox 5% EC at 1 mL/L. Spiromesifen at 0.75 mL/L for resistant populations.
similar_outbreaks_globally: India: Spider mite outbreak - Rajasthan and Gujarat (2022)
Brazil: Mite infestation - Tomato, Sao Paulo state (2023)

symptoms: Brown lesions with distinct concentric ring patterns on leaves
Yellow halo surrounding lesions
Lesions on stems, petioles, and fruit surface
Defoliation in severe infections
Tomato___Target_Spot.organic_treatment: Apply copper hydroxide (50% at 2g/L) every 7-10 days. Remove infected leaves and debris. Improve plant spacing and air circulation.
Tomato___Target_Spot.chemical_treatment: Apply Boscalid 50% WG at 0.5g/L or Azoxystrobin 23% SC at 1 mL/L. Alternate with Chlorothalonil 75% WP at 2g/L to prevent resistance.
similar_outbreaks_globally: India: Tomato target spot - Andhra Pradesh (2022)

symptoms: Severe upward curling and cupping of leaves
Interveinal chlorosis - leaves turn yellow between veins
Stunted plant growth, greatly reduced plant size
Total flower and fruit abortion in early infection - zero yield
environmental_factors: Transmitted by Bemisia tabaci (silverleaf whitefly) vector
Warm conditions (25-35 C) favor whitefly population explosion
No cure once plant is infected
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.organic_treatment: No cure - focus on vector control. Apply neem oil (5 mL/L) + soap spray every 5 days to kill whiteflies. Use yellow sticky traps. Install 40-mesh insect-proof nets over nursery beds. Remove and destroy infected plants immediately.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.chemical_treatment: Control whitefly vector: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL at 0.3 mL/L as soil drench at transplanting. Spirotetramat at 0.6 mL/L as foliar. Plant TYLCV-resistant hybrids (Arka Rakshak, Pusa Rohini).
similar_outbreaks_globally: India: TYLCV epidemic - Andhra Pradesh, Telangana (2022)
China: Tomato yellow curl - Hainan, Shandong (2023)
Brazil: TYLCV in Sao Paulo tomato belt (2023)

symptoms: Mosaic pattern of light and dark green mottling on leaves
Leaf distortion, fernleaf, and leaf filiforming
Internal brown streaking in fruits
Stunted plant growth and reduced fruit set
environmental_factors: Mechanically transmitted by contaminated hands, tools, and clothing
Highly stable virus - persists in dried plant material for years
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.organic_treatment: Use certified virus-free seed. Disinfect tools with 10% trisodium phosphate (TSP) or bleach between plants. Remove and destroy infected plants. Wash hands before handling plants.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.chemical_treatment: No curative chemical available. Preventive: Apply Virus-X plant extract bioprotectant at 2 mL/L. Control aphid and mechanical vectors using Imidacloprid 17.8% SL.
similar_outbreaks_globally: India: Tomato mosaic - Punjab protected cultivation (2022)

symptoms: No disease symptoms detected. Leaves are green, flat, and free of spots.
Tomato___healthy.organic_treatment: Maintain regular IPM scouting. Apply balanced NPK fertilizer. Use drip irrigation. Stake plants for proper air circulation.
Tomato___healthy.chemical_treatment: No treatment required. Continue preventive copper spray program as calendar-based schedule.
